name: Colorblind
description: One destination-square color is forbidden and independently rerandomized each affected-player turn.
ambiguities: The random choice is stable throughout one affected-player turn and advances after that player's move.
If every ordinary legal move lands on the forbidden color, the generic no-drawback-legal-move loss applies.
Castling, promotion, and en-passant are classified by the primary piece's destination square.

name: Hand and Brainless
description: One required primary mover type is independently rerandomized each affected-player turn.
ambiguities: Piece includes pawns and the king, producing six approximately uniform primary mover types from a deterministic uint32 mapping.
The literal must-move interpretation has no fallback when the selected type has no ordinary legal move; the generic no-drawback-legal-move loss then applies.
Promotions are pawn moves and castling is a king move.

name: Obsession
description: One target square is rerandomized each affected-player turn; if any ordinary move reaches it, one of those moves is required.
ambiguities: All 64 squares are sampled uniformly, including occupied and unreachable squares.
When no ordinary legal move reaches the sampled square, the restriction is inactive for that turn.
All legal promotion choices reaching the target remain available.

name: Winds of Fate
description: Either player-relative leftward or rightward primary movement is forbidden and independently rerandomized each affected-player turn.
ambiguities: Left and right are interpreted from the affected player's perspective, so file direction is mirrored for Black.
Moves with no horizontal displacement remain legal.
Castling, promotion, and en-passant use the primary piece's from-to file displacement.
